name: PNGS Gargi Fashion Jewellery Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2009, PNGS Gargi 
Fashion Jewellery Ltd does trading
fashion jewellery, articles of silver 
and other articles[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PNGS is in the retail business of costume and fashion jewellery under the brand name Gargi by P. N. Gadgil & Sons which was launched in FY21 under the fashion jewellery segment. Company deals in 92.5% certified sterling silver jewellery, brass and copper jewellery, idols, and other gift articles. It commenced commercial sale of 14 Carat Gold studded with natural diamond jewellery from October 2023. Currently, the company has ~1 Online Store, Offline Store 
 ~36, Jewellery Designs ~1 Million

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 42.0%
cons: Stock is trading at 9.27 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -1.93%
Debtor days have increased from 18.0 to 40.0 days.
